home.title: 喜马拉雅静修，寻求清晰与宁静
home.subtitle: 在喜马拉雅精心策划的体验——为清晰、休息和有意义的工作而设计。
home.intro: The Mountain Whisper 在尼泊尔喜马拉雅的中心提供正念静修，在那里宁静成为老师，海拔带来清晰。在这里，在峰峦和山谷之间的安静空间中，您会找到一直在寻求的重置——不是逃避，而是回归。

silence.title: 寂静
silence.text: 在喜马拉雅，寂静不是空的——它是满的。充满了清晰、视角和那种让您听到真正重要事物的宁静。远离现代生活的持续噪音，寂静成为老师。

elevation.title: 海拔
elevation.text: 身体的海拔带来心理的海拔。当您上升时，日常的噪音逐渐消失。剩下的就是本质。您走得越高，看得越清楚——不仅是风景，还有您自己前进的道路。

clarity.title: 超越常规的清晰
clarity.text: 我们的旅程旨在打破让您陷入困境的模式。通过在自然最强大的空间中度过有意识的时间，您会找到在日常常规中难以捉摸的清晰。带着改变您工作、领导和生活方式的观点返回。

intentional.title: 有意识的生活
intentional.text: The Mountain Whisper 是关于为反思、工作和休息创造空间。不是逃避，而是回归。不是退缩，而是清晰。

waysToExperience.title: 体验方式
waysToExperience.subtitle: 人们以不同的方式体验 The Mountain Whisper。每条路径都提供自己的节奏，自己的深度。

journeys.title: 旅程
journeys.description: 精心策划的体验，为清晰、休息和有意义的工作而设计。不同的节奏，不同的持续时间，每个都有意图。

work.title: 从喜马拉雅工作
work.description: 为创始人、远程团队和独立建设者提供的宁静静修。在山区进行深度工作和宁静。

soloOrShared.title: 独自或共享
soloOrShared.description: 无论您是独自一人还是与他人一起，体验都会适应。个人反思或共同提升——两条路径都通向清晰。

custom.title: 定制旅程
custom.description: 为那些寻求特定事物的人。我们设计满足您所在位置的体验，具有您需要的节奏和焦点。

altitude.title: 海拔
altitude.text: 身体的海拔创造心理的海拔。当您上升时，日常的噪音逐渐消失。剩下的就是本质。

stillness.title: 宁静
stillness.text: 喜马拉雅提供越来越罕见的东西：真正的宁静。没有Wi-Fi区域。没有紧急通知。只有屹立千年的山脉，教导耐心。

perspective.title: 视角
perspective.text: 从高处，您看得不同。在海平面感觉压倒性的问题缩小到适当的大小。似乎紧急的优先事项揭示了它们的真正重要性。

whyExists.title: 为什么存在
whyExists.text1: 我在快节奏的环境中工作了多年，一切都感觉紧急。截止日期堆积，需要快速做出决定，节奏从未放缓。
whyExists.text2: 更接近自然的工作，特别是在喜马拉雅，改变了我对工作和生活的态度。山脉教会我，放慢速度不是做得更少——而是有意图地做重要的事情。
whyExists.text3: The Mountain Whisper 为那些深深关心自己的工作但希望有意图地工作的其他人而存在。

cta.title: 开始对话
cta.subtitle: 告诉我们您正在寻找什么——我们会深思熟虑地指导您。

whatThisIs.title: What This Really Is
whatThisIs.notCoworking: This is not a coworking space.
whatThisIs.notWorkshop: This is not a productivity workshop.
whatThisIs.text1: Work From the Himalayas is a space for people who want to work or create with clarity, in one of the quietest landscapes on earth.
whatThisIs.text2: The best work happens when you have space to think. When the environment supports focus rather than urgency. When stillness becomes a condition for clarity.
whatThisIs.text3: You work. The mountains provide the context. The quiet provides the space. Together, they create conditions where deep thinking becomes possible.

founders.title: Founders and co-founders
founders.text: Builders who need quiet space to think, plan, and create without the constant noise of daily operations.

teams.title: Small teams
teams.text: Teams seeking a calm environment to work together while experiencing the stillness of the mountains.

creators.title: Writers, artists, researchers
creators.text: People whose work requires uninterrupted time and deep thinking. Writers finishing manuscripts. Musicians composing. Painters beginning series.

environments.title: Work-friendly environments
environments.text: We curate spaces that support focus. Quiet rooms, natural light, and environments designed for thinking. Location-dependent, but always intentional.

rhythm.title: Flexible daily rhythm
rhythm.text: No rigid schedules. No mandatory activities. Structure your days around your work and the natural rhythm that emerges in stillness.

space.title: Space for focus, rest, and reflection
space.text: Work deeply. Rest when needed. Take walks. Reflect. The environment supports all of it — because the best work happens when you're not exhausted.

support.title: Support without intrusion
support.text: Local support is available when you need it. Guidance, not management. Help, not oversight. You work. We ensure the environment supports that.

differentWay.title: A Different Way of Working
differentWay.text1: Productivity is measured in clarity, not hours. When you have space to think and the environment supports focus, you accomplish more with less effort.
differentWay.text2: No constant notifications. No urgent interruptions. Just work when you need to work. Rest when you need to rest.
differentWay.text3: The mountains teach patience. The quiet teaches presence. You return not just with work done, but with clarity about what matters.

seasons.title: Seasons and timing
seasons.text: Different seasons offer different experiences. We'll guide you on the best times for your stay, considering weather, connectivity, and the kind of stillness you're seeking.

altitude.title: Altitude and suitability
altitude.text: We work with locations that are safe and manageable. For higher elevation options, we ensure proper acclimatization and support. Your well-being is our priority.

connectivity.title: Connectivity
connectivity.text: Some locations offer reliable internet. Others offer reliable quiet. We're transparent about what to expect, so you can choose based on your work requirements.

notForEveryone.title: Who this may not be ideal for
notForEveryone.text: If you need constant connectivity, prefer urban environments, or require extensive infrastructure, this may not be the right fit. We're honest about limitations because we want you to make the right choice.

places.title: Places
places.subtitle: Places chosen for stillness, light, and distance from urgency. Where work experiences unfold.

manang.name: Manang
manang.description: High valleys where silence settles between peaks. A high-altitude Himalayan village defined by stillness and long pauses.

cta.title: Begin a Conversation
cta.subtitle: Share what you're working on and what you need. We'll suggest a calm fit that supports your work.

journeys.title: Journeys into Stillness
journeys.subtitle: A small collection of curated experiences shaped by mountains, silence, and time.

cta.title: Begin a Conversation
cta.subtitle: Not sure which journey fits? We'll help you choose.

enquire.title: Start a conversation
enquire.subtitle: Tell us what you're seeking. There's no commitment — just a thoughtful exchange.

form.name: Name
form.messageHint: You can share as much or as little as you like — an idea, a question, or an intention.
form.success: Thank you for your message. We've received your enquiry and will respond thoughtfully soon.
form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
form.responseTime: We usually reply within 24–48 hours. No pressure.
form.reassurance: We read every message carefully. There's no automated reply, no pressure, and no expectation — just a thoughtful response.

manang.title: Manang
manang.description: A high-altitude Himalayan village defined by silence and long pauses. The pace here is slow. The air is thin. The light is clear.

stillness.title: Stillness
stillness.text: Stillness here is not absence. It's presence. The kind of quiet that allows you to hear what you've been missing. Days move slowly. Evenings stretch. Time becomes spacious.

light.title: Light
light.text: Light at altitude is different. Clearer. More direct. It illuminates not just the landscape but your thinking. The clarity you seek often comes with the clarity of light.

altitude.title: Altitude
altitude.text: Altitude requires patience. Your body adjusts. Your mind adjusts. The process itself teaches something about slowing down, about respecting limits, about the value of gradual change.

simplicity.title: Simplicity
simplicity.text: Simplicity is not deprivation. It's focus. Fewer distractions. Fewer choices. What remains is what matters. This simplicity supports the kind of thinking that gets lost in complexity.

deepWork.title: Deep work
deepWork.text: The quiet, the altitude, the simplicity—they create conditions where focus becomes natural. You work without the constant pull of distraction.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.text: The long pauses between activities. The walks. The stillness. These moments allow you to process and understand.

thinking.title: Long-form thinking
thinking.text: The kind of sustained thought that requires time and space. Problems that felt intractable begin to resolve.

practical.title: Practical Information
practical.subtitle: Essential details about facilities, services, and what to expect

healthPost.name: Manang Health Post
healthPost.description: Basic medical services available in the village

altitude.name: Altitude Sickness Support
altitude.description: Local guides trained in recognizing and managing altitude-related issues

evacuation.name: Emergency Evacuation
evacuation.description: Helicopter evacuation available for serious medical emergencies

gangapurna.name: Gangapurna Lake
gangapurna.description: Short walk from the village. A peaceful spot for reflection

iceLake.name: Ice Lake (Kicho Tal)
iceLake.description: Day hike destination. High-altitude lake with stunning mountain views

milarepa.name: Milarepa Cave
milarepa.description: Historic meditation cave. A place of quiet significance

internet.name: Internet Access
internet.description: Limited and intermittent. Best for essential communication only

mobile.name: Mobile Network
mobile.description: Spotty coverage. Some areas have better signal than others

power.name: Power Supply
power.description: Electricity available but can be unreliable. Solar power recommended for devices

lodges.name: Lodges & Guesthouses
lodges.description: Simple, comfortable accommodations. Basic amenities available

dining.name: Dining
dining.description: Local teahouses serve traditional Nepali and Tibetan cuisine

supplies.name: Supplies
supplies.description: Basic supplies available. Limited selection. Plan accordingly

altitude.title: Altitude
altitude.text: Manang sits at approximately 3,540 meters (11,614 feet). This requires proper acclimatization. Some people adjust quickly. Others need more time. We ensure proper support and pacing. Your well-being matters more than any schedule.

connectivity.title: Connectivity Limitations
connectivity.text: Internet access is limited. This is intentional. The quiet that makes deep work possible also means less connectivity. If your work requires constant online presence or real-time collaboration, this may not be the right fit.

notForEveryone.title: Not for Everyone
notForEveryone.text: This place is not for everyone. If you need urban comforts, reliable connectivity, or extensive infrastructure, look elsewhere. We're honest about limitations because we want you to choose what actually serves you.

workCta.title: Work from the Himalayas
workCta.text: Manang is suitable for work-focused stays. For people comfortable with simplicity and altitude. If you need quiet space to think, to write, to build, this place offers that.
